reviews.text: Truly the best place to take your pet when it's time for them cross the rainbow bridge. Everyone is so kind and compassionate. They truly make it easier to say your final goodbye.

Dr. Ishak came to our home the same day, after hours, when we had to make the heartbreaking decision to put our elderly dog down. He was calm, kind, and incredibly patient while our entire family struggled with saying goodbye to our best friend, Rumpel.

He made sure Rumpel was comfortable and free from pain, and allowed him to pass peacefully at home, surrounded by the people who loved him. He gave us all the time we needed. We were also able to let our younger dog say goodbye, which meant more to us than we can put into words.

This was one of the hardest days we’ve ever had, and we’re very grateful for the care Dr. Ishak showed our family. Thank you for helping us say goodbye to our beloved pet.

I am extremely grateful to Valley Vet Care for what they do, unfortunately one Sunday morning my dog took a turn for the worst and I could not find a veterinarian that was open and I could not move my dog due to his condition. Unfortunately I had to make the decision to put him down to stop his suffering, I could not find another mobile euthanasia service that was available, VVC did their absolute best to come to me ASAP, when they did they immediately knew my dog was in a terminal stage and they very professionally and quickly sedated him to end his suffering and we were able to spend a few moments with our dog to properly say goodbye without him suffering, after that he very efficiently and peacefully put him to sleep. Amazing service and I will always be thankful. 10/10
No empathy. Straight to business. It was so painful and then the ashes were lost for weeks. Never again.

Save yourself even more heartbreak and choose a company that leads with empathy and compassion. My experience with Valley Vet Care made an already devastating situation far worse and still haunts me to this day. The lack of care and sensitivity during my dog Koala’s euthanasia was shocking. I wouldn’t recommend this company to anyone who truly loves their pet and wants their final moments to be peaceful and respectful. There are much better mobile euthanasia services in the area. My girl deserved better 💔

Very poor customer service.
I rarely leave negative reviews, but my experience here was disappointing. The staff seemed uninterested in helping. I waited for a while to receive an order that was never delivered to me. I requested help and first, I was sent a picture of the supposed proof of delivery, the picture was of someone's shoes inside of a truck. Once I pointed that out to customer service, they proceeded to forward me the "coordinates" of the delivery location. What do people do with coordinates and how helpful is that in finding a package that was never left at my door? - don't know. I was only asking for some accountability since its obvious something went wrong with this transaction. Does not take a genius to realize this was awful business from the start.  I won’t be returning, and I’d recommend others look elsewhere for better service.

This company has all the compassion of a tree trimmer. They were cold and clearly in a rush to euthanize my dog so they could leave. When they carried away my best friend, she was put into the trunk of a Tesla that was so full of trash, they barely had space for my dog. It made an already terrible day exponentially worse.

This "GUY"!
"Obviously"! In the "WRONG"! 👎
Profession. …

Our old dog became very ill very quickly. Dr Ishak came to our house, after hours on a Friday night, to help Toby cross over the rainbow bridge. He was very kind, patient and professional during the difficult time of losing a family member. We were grateful we could say goodbye to our boy at home.

They came to help Sully cross the Rainbow Bridge. They were very kind, compassionate and caring. They took all the time we needed to say Good Bye. Highly Recommend them if you ever need their services. It's a sad and hard thing to do, but they made it easier because they cared not just about Sully, but about us.
Very compassionate personnel, they waited for us to say goodbye to our dog. Very professional, definitely recommend them.

They made the experience a little bit easier..very caring and professional team .. it’s always hard to say goodbye to our fur babies that is such a big part of our family.. at home our dog was comfortable in his house in our arms .. This was a hard time putting our peanut down .. he had 16 long years  could ask for a better way and Dr. Ishak was understanding and patient .

On June 30th, my cat’s health declined so quickly that I had to make the heartbreaking decision to put him to sleep. The vet I had used before wasn’t available, so I started searching and ended up choosing this company. In the moment, I was overwhelmed and emotional, focused only on saying goodbye to my best friend. But now that I’ve had time to reflect, I realize how cold and rushed the whole experience was… and it breaks my heart that this is how his final moments went.

When the doctor arrived, the first thing he did was hand me a form to sign. I don’t think he introduced himself. Then he immediately pulled out the medications and briefly said that one was a sedative and the other was the final shot. That was the extent of the explanation, no details, no comfort, no effort to help me understand what was about to happen. When he gave the first shot, my cat flinched and pulled his paw away, it clearly hurt him. The doctor then waved his fingers in front of his eyes and told me that he was sedated. But my cat wasn’t even reacting to movement before the injection. If the doctor had taken even a moment to ask me about my cat’s condition, he would’ve known that. But he didn’t ask me a single question.

After giving the second shot, he told me my cat had passed. I was holding him, crying, trying to process what had just happened. The doctor asked if I wanted fur, and of course I said yes, but instead of treating that moment with care, he just snipped off a chunk and handed it to me, without anything to put it in. Someone else had to grab a tissue to wrap it. And then, he just packed up his things and left. No goodbye. Didn’t say a word. Just got up and left. The whole thing was over in less than 10 minutes.

There was no compassion. No empathy. Just routine steps like my cat was just another job to check off the list. I feel sick thinking that these were Arez’s final moments, because he deserved better. He wasn’t “just a cat.” He was my baby. My family. He was with me through so many years of my life, and I wanted his goodbye to be peaceful and full of care. But it didn’t feel like that. It felt rushed. Distant. Cold.

I wish I had read the reviews before calling them, because I never would have chosen this company. If you’re going through the pain of losing a pet, please think twice. Our animals deserve to be treated with love and respect at the very end. I’m grateful I was there to hold Arez and let him know how much he was loved, but I’ll always carry the pain of how it was handled.

He deserved so much more.
Valley Vet Care was incredibly compassionate and professional during a very difficult decision for our family. They really made the best of a tough time for our family.

After watching our puppy of 17 years decline, we decided it was time to put her down. I am so thankful that we could do this in our home. Our pup was always anxious when going to the doctor and this way she was in the comfort of her home surrounded and held by those she loved and who loved her. The doctor and his assistant were knowledgeable, gentle and kind, and helped guide us through the process. I would highly recommend them.

They were very kind, compassionate and helpful during such a sad and difficult time. From the phone call inquiring to when they arrived at our house. They allowed us time to love on our beloved, grieve and provided guidance as to what was to come. Thank you.

Our beloved older dog, Rooney, began to decline in health just before the 4th of July holiday. Wanting to be prepared, we gathered contact information for home pet euthanasia services, hoping we would have the weekend with him. Sadly, his condition worsened rapidly on the evening of July 5th, and the places we had planned to call were closed.

In a moment of desperation, we found Valley Vet Care through a Google search and reached out via text. Dr. Ishak responded immediately. We were incredibly grateful that he was available to come to our home on such short notice, especially so late in the evening during a holiday weekend.

Tragically, our sweet boy passed peacefully in my husband’s arms before Dr. Ishak arrived. When he and his assistant came, they treated our Rooney with the utmost care and dignity. His assistant gently placed him in a soft bed, giving us a quiet moment to say our final goodbyes before she carried him out. The paperwork and visit were brief, compassionate, and professional.

This was one of the hardest nights we’ve experienced, but knowing someone was on their way to help brought us some comfort in the midst of heartbreak. We sincerely thank Dr. Ishak and his team for their kindness, responsiveness, and care. We will miss our sweet boy forever.

We needed same-day euthanasia for our dog on a Saturday, and this service exceeded all expectations. From the first phone call, they were fast, informative, and kind. They made a very difficult day more bearable with their professionalism and compassion.

Unlike many other providers we contacted, they did not charge extra for a weekend or same-day appointment. That kind of transparency and fairness meant a lot to us during such an emotional time. While price isn't the most important factor in these moments, their affordability was a relief—especially given that the quality of service never suffered.

The process was simple, respectful, and humane. They took the time to explain everything and gave us the space we needed. I’m incredibly grateful for the care and empathy they showed. I would recommend them to anyone facing this painful decision.
Dr. Ishak was wonderful! He came out the same day I called as I could no longer watch my beloved dog of 15 years suffer.  He was so kind and compassionate. I cannot say enough good things about him.
Very kind and compassionate towards both my beloved girl as well as myself.

I had to let my baby go after 14 years of pure love. The house doesn't feel right without her. Run with your sisters little one. I would recommend Valley Vet Care to anyone who needs to do this. I did in home and she wasn't scared at all. Bless them at my time of need. Love you Brittany 🌈💔🐾 …

Such a tough and emotional day as we peacefully said our ‘goodbyes to our k9 family member’ Valley Vet Care was so respectful, kind and professional which truly made it easier. Thank you to the team, process & explaining everything, waiting until we were ready. Handled with class & respect, so thank you!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review.
Informative and professional. Made a hard deal a little easier.

I would recommend these guys to anyone. We had called everyone and they were either not available or went to voicemail. These guys were my last call and they picked up almost immediately. They made time for me that same day and were very professional. Thank you for this service you provide and for making it as painless as a process as it can be.

The experience I had haunts me 3 years later hence why I am posting this. This gentleman showed no compassion when putting my most precious dog to rest. He didn’t explain anything up front, which definitely could have helped me understand the process. He injected her with the first shot that makes the dog go limp, then decided to collect payment with her alive but limp in my lap! He was having difficulties with his credit card reader meanwhile I’m bawling with my dog  in my lap who is still alive able to hear everything going on around her but is paralyzed. He proceeded to then get out the clippers to shave a spot although she already had a shaved spot due to going to the dr multiple times in that week. Then once he finally put her down I felt extremely rushed but from other reviews I have read that seems to be his normal. Do better. Collect payment before services not during. Allow time for the person to grieve, hell I would have even paid extra if that was what was needed. 4 months later had to put my senior cat to sleep. I used a different vet and was astounded at the level of care I received. More recently experienced 2 more at home euthanasias with my friends’ dogs. The service that was provided to them was great which further reminded me of what a terrible moment I had in choosing this Dr.

It’s been a year now since we lost our best girl. There is a review that I can 100% relate to .. THE WORST EXPERIENCE THAT STILL EFFECTS / HAUNTS  US TODAY. DO NOT USE THIS GUY! Please!!!! Did not introduce himself, did not acknowledge my pup or even show any compassion. Went right to signing the papers! He was so
In a hurry it was disgusting! Without any warning, he sticks my pup, she yelps, and then he sticks her again! This is all while she is sitting up! Then she goes down! Doesn’t bother him none! He never once asked if we were ok.. . It took him about 10 sticks to find a vein! Heart wrenching! Again, no
Compassion what so ever! It was the worst experience ever! He then gets a body bag and asked my boyfriend , who is a complete mess to help put her in the bag… then asked to help carry her out to his Tesla to place  her in the trunk???? Just unacceptable! Just wrong. Just very very sad. PLEASE DO NOT GO WITH THIS ESTABLISHMENT. Your baby DOES NOT DESERVE THIS! PLEASE KEEP RESEARCHING!

One of our cats, who had been sick for awhile finally spiraled on a Saturday morning and the time had come to say "goodbye for now". I looked at several different at home services and even considered an animal hospital but ultimately we decided to go with Valley Vet Care. We didn't want to put the cat through anymore stress of a car ride or a strange place. It's also was much better to say goodbye at home.

The price was fair from looking around but the service and process made things simple during an emotional time. Dr. Ishak came and was very patient and friendly explaining the entire process. We had spent the day saying our goodbyes so we were ready once the time came but there was no rush. We elected to have him cremated by himself and received his ashes and paw print within a week.

Thank you Dr. Ishak and Valley Vet Care.

I am very grateful for the service Valley Vet Care provided.  I got an appointment the same morning that I called.  The vet was efficient and considerate for my situation.  The cost was fair and $75 was taken off, after my Buster died before the vet arrived.

They put our Wiley down when it began to feel wrong not to. It is a very hard decision to make and it helps to have vets that are as good as these guys are to do it. They can take the body or leave it for home burial, they can also cremate them and tgey make a paw print keepsake. Thanks Valley Vet Care for helping us and Wiley. We miss her so much but at least she's no longer in pain.

Everything about this experience was perfect (considering the circumstances). They were actually able to come out same-day, which was so appreciated. The two injection protocol is absolutely ideal; my kitty was able to fall "asleep" in my arms on the couch and then we did the final injection after she was sedated. He also made sure to ask me where I would like the final injection to be given, which I thought was so sweet. He explained everything very well before anything happened, and they both (the doctor and tech) were gentle and comforting. And honestly, the price point for the house call is one of the best I've found. I appreciate everything, thank you!

Editing: I made sure to have Dr. Ishak come over to help me let go of my last kitty, Velcro. He remembered us and was so sweet and helped make the hard decision as peaceful as possible. I just don't have enough great things to say about this practice!

I've waited nearly a full year to write this review because I was so upset at the way this place handled the euthanasia for my poor boy, an 11 year old Labrador Retriever. I've used Lap of Love before and naively believed that any home euthanasia vet would be skilled in handling the last moments. I was WRONG. I'm not even sure of this guy's name because he did not take a moment to introduce himself or make any cursory small talk during a very stressful moment. He was accompanied by a "helper" who likewise was just there to do a job. Neither did any small talk or offer any words of kindness or sorrow. The vet jabbed my poor boy with the first injection and my boy cried out in pain. Without saying a word, the vet got out the second injection but I told him to wait as the first had not taken effect to calm my boy. Obviously this guy was in a hurry because he pushed to inject the euthanasia drug and was irritated at waiting. When he finally administered the drug, his assistant went out and got a body bag from the car. A BODY BAG. They scooped up my boy, put him in the bag and took him to the car. Again, not a word of kindness, sympathy or condolences. What a horrible, horrible experience. It brings tears just reliving this to write this review. I would NEVER have this guy out again. Lap of Love was unavailable on the day my boy needed the service and I regret not waiting until they were able to come but I did not want my boy to suffer. Instead I hired a vet with the skill of a butcher.

Valley vet care was amazing they explained everything they were gonna do before they did it. Gave us time to say are good bye before and after and never made it feel rushed or un valued . Highly recommend them.
The Dr came out and helped me through a difficult time. Penny passed on gently and free of pain. The asked were returned and she is now home again. Thank you.

Compassionate, kind and patient. Dr. Ishak made this very difficult process bearable as we said goodbye to our baby in the comfort our own home. We didn't have to make that drive to and back and our 20 y.o. cat was in her home when she left this world. We highly recommend this service to anyone. It was much more peaceful than going to the vets office.
What a blessing to b able to say goodbye at your house. Dr was caring and compationate during this difficult time. Highly recommend.

This was one of the hardest things I ever had to do. I did some research and found Dr. Ishak who was highly recommended and more budget friendly than other doctors. The doctor and his assistant came the day after I set the appointment. They were on time and very respectful of my emotional state. It was very hard on me. They allowed me time to grieve and even delivered the ashes to me, no charge. This is a heartbreaking situation to be in. If you find yourself in this situation, I highly recommend Dr. Ishak.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review.
During a very sad time in my life valley vet care got us through with kindness and compassion for our loss. My old pup never felt a thing and now is in a happy place. Rainbow bridge!

Valley Vet was very responsive and available the next morning. They were on time. Very professional, explained what was going to happen. Gave me all the time I needed to be with my almost 15 year old schnauzer. It was very quick, painless, and peaceful. I appreciate Valley Vet taking care of my Bella.
Kept me well informed about the appointment,  their process,  and offered to answer any questions.  I was able to hold my dog the whole time and comfort him,  which was very important to me.

Dr. Ishak was able to come to us Earlier than our appointment because our girl was doing so poorly.  He sat down beside her In a cramped spot on our back patio, where we had her on her dog bed. He insisted that we not move her. I was very touched.

INSENSITIVE - I made an appointment for 5:00 PM on a Friday. It was what was available and I wanted every bit of time left with my Lab. They called at 11:30 in the morning to ask if I would be interested in moving the appointment up. I said I wasn't interested and wanted all of the time I had left with my pup. They called again at 4:15 and said they were 20 minutes away. I told them that they can wait until 5:00 PM and no sooner. What a cold and insensitive bunch. I would NOT recommend this outfit to anyone. I'm sorry that they did not want to drive back after 5:00 PM on a Friday evening. If that is the case, then don't offer that time as available on your schedule. Maybe your company would benefit from some sensitivity training and focus just a little bit less on your personal and financial needs.
Extremely professional and compassionate.  Thank you

I want to thank ValleyVetCarr for such an incredible, peaceful and calm experience yesterday. Sad, yes, but I appreciate everything you did for Bently and I.

I picked this company because I was there when they put my cousins St Bernard down a few weeks ago and experienced the same vibe.

Thank you! ❤️‍🩹

Dr. Ishak has been a source of reliability & comfort in our times of need. We recently had to put my 19.5 year old sweet kitty Athena to rest due to CKD. The process, while incredibly difficult to have to go thru, was made easier with the love, care & attention Dr. Ishak & his assistant showed our girl on her final day.

We have used his services once before on 2021 when our previous kitty needed help transitioning & we have nothing but good things to say. He is compassionate, informative & professional. Doing this at home is a priority for us, for the comfort of our pets. They offer cremation packages as well & their pricing is very reasonable.

If needed again in the future, I will absolutely use their services again & will recommend them to friends & family that might need these services as well.
Great service, highly recommended. Thank you for your kindness and sympathy during a very difficult time. I appreciate your help with my cat Dexter. 🐈 …

Over the decades I’ve had to euthanize a number of my pet children.  As animal-lovers all know, it’s one of the most traumatic of life’s experiences.  Dr. Ishak and his staff are the most caring, thoughtful and supportive people with whom I’ve ever dealt.  I can’t thank them enough.  Thank you so very much.

It’s never easy to decide to euthanize a pet. I’m so grateful to Dr. Ishak for making the process as simple as possible and in the comfort of our home. He explained the process before hand and took great care with my cat. I’m so thankful for a way to give my cat peace without the stress of having to travel to a clinic at the end of her life.

This was one of the most difficult moments to bare. Dr. Ishak was able to come the next day to our home. Our sweet girl, Rigby was surrounded by her whole family, my husband held her head until she was gone. The process was easy, calm, had clear communication and was respectful. Dr. Ishak explained what he was doing as he was doing it and what to expect. Rigby passed so quietly. They  respectfully stepped out to give us time for the final goodbye.  I am so thankful to have found them, it was painful emotionally but the whole process was done quick, respectful and cost efficient for us. Highly recommend.

I would place 0 stars if I could. Dr. Ishak did not properly introduce himself or his assistant to the other family members in the home with the dog. The assistant didn’t say a word the entire time. Dr. Ishak approached us as we were gathered around our dog and all crying, with a syringe in his hand. Dr. Ishak did not explain the process thoroughly. He said maybe two sentences about the process. He BARELY let our dog sniff his gloved hands before injecting her with the first dose. He did not once talk to her or say her name to her. The dog was surprised after being poked and got up (which was painful for her). Dr. Ishak said to us as we were sobbing after she passed away, “do you want us to take the body”. Body! I could not believe the callousness. The entire experience felt cold, clinical, and rushed. I now am grappling with the grief of losing my dog, and with thoughts that she was scared and alarmed before dying. They then drove off with our dog in a Tesla with no markings on the car about the company. It was horrible. Families - DO NOT use this service.

I was grateful that Dr. Ishak came to my house on the day that I needed him. He answered the phone immediately when I called him, notified me in advance that he was on his way and arrived at the exact time that he promised. He was very kind and walked me through the process. It was a sad day for me but the experience brought me comfort.

WOW is the only word I can think of when expressing my extreme gratitude for this caring kind, compassion (even loving), gentle, warm, thoughtful, caring  team! I actually believe they were angels sent to me to get through this time and …
